headerDisplay:
**Sonos Control Pro** — dine musikscener som kontakter i Apple Home. Alt styres lokalt over netværket; ingen sky, ingen hub.

*Your music scenes as switches in Apple Home. Everything is controlled locally over the network — no cloud, no hub.*
footerDisplay: Scenerne gemmes i `sonos-control-pro/scenes.json` ved siden af din Homebridge-config. Alt andet — højttalere, favoritter, scener og afprøvning — foregår i plugin'ets egen backend. *Scenes live in `sonos-control-pro/scenes.json` next to your Homebridge config. Everything else — speakers, favourites, scenes and testing — happens in the plugin's own backend.*
